Issaquah Library adds tools to its checkout collection

Library cardholders can borrow dozens of tools for free starting Oct. 10
by Zoe BuchliSeptember 18, 2026September 18, 2026

Share this:

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

Issaquah Library will be the first King County Library System (KCLS) location to pilot a new tool-rental program next month, available for anyone with a KCLS card.

The Curiosity Collection is launching Oct. 10. The collection brings dozens of multipurpose tools that help with home, auto and bike repairs for free rental use at the Issaquah Library.
